projects.title: Sabor na Medida Delivery
projects.description: End-to-end delivery platform with a multilingual storefront, PIX payments via InfinitePay, multichannel integration with iFood, 99Food, and Keeta via webhooks, a real-time admin panel, order tracking, thermal receipt printing, and a WhatsApp AI assistant (n8n + multi-LLM cascade) that takes and validates orders 24/7.

projects.title: TaskFlow
projects.description: A multi-tenant SaaS project management platform for software teams (~25k lines of code). Includes a native MCP server that enables AI agents (Claude, Cursor) to execute tasks autonomously through 42+ RLS-protected endpoints.

projects.title: TrakkerAi
projects.description: Native Android application built with Kotlin and Supabase, published on Google Play for expense tracking and budget management, featuring AI-powered automatic expense recognition from images, receipts, and PDF files.

projects.title: The Cuban Touch
projects.description: Online food delivery and ordering web platform designed, developed, and launched as a production-ready MVP with a digital menu, shopping cart, and order management.

projects.title: MCM — MikroTik Network Manager
projects.description: A comprehensive suite for orchestration, provisioning, and QoS on MikroTik routers (RouterOS). Combines a native desktop client (macOS/Windows), a web dashboard, and a persistent headless agent on an Oracle VPS. Manages simple queues, Queue Tree, and PCQ groups with isolation policies, wireless frequency scanning, network topology, and encrypted SFTP backups.

projects.title: Hermes — Autonomous Agent & Ops
projects.description: An autonomous agent and observability platform for Oracle Cloud infrastructure. Orchestrates critical tasks through systemd timers, host monitors, and preventive security (Fail2Ban/SSH). Integrates a bidirectional bridge for WhatsApp and Telegram, centralizing alerts and network events across the fleet.

projects.title: Solarman Energy Monitor
projects.description: A real-time IoT telemetry system for photovoltaic solar inverters and battery storage banks using Modbus/uModbus. Integrated with Hermes for continuous metric collection, generation/consumption analysis, and early alerts during grid outages.

projects.title: LTE Control Center
projects.description: A local cellular telemetry and SMS management dashboard for Huawei LTE modems (B311-221), accessible over LAN and WireGuard. Monitors radio frequency metrics (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR), bands, and traffic in real time, with automated Telegram alerts for connection failures or new messages.

projects.title: CLAVE — Voice AI Assistant
projects.description: An autonomous voice assistant for macOS inspired by JARVIS. Orchestrates local speech recognition (Whisper) and speech synthesis (Piper) models with Claude to execute system commands (battery, volume, brightness, network), window management, home automation, and voice-driven workflows.

details: I lead technical strategy, software architecture, and infrastructure for independent clients and highly available internal products.

I design and operate the autonomous observability and AI agent platform (Hermes) on Oracle Cloud, integrating solar energy telemetry (Solarman), cellular control (LTE), and advanced MikroTik network management (MCM).
I manage full-cycle development environments, resolving complex package dependency conflicts and carrying out seamless environment migrations to Laravel 13.
I develop and scale enterprise software for asset and inventory management.
I integrate complex third-party APIs to drive data automation and interoperability between systems.
I review web pull requests, ensuring strict adherence to code quality and architecture standards.
I initiated and designed a major architectural upgrade of the Kunapak Admin platform, using a decoupled Astro and Laravel stack to modernize administrative workflows and enhance system capabilities.
I reorganized server infrastructure in Dokploy, moving from a centralized model to a distributed one by separating databases, APIs, and frontend applications to maximize stability.
I containerized the company’s entire IT product suite (Backend, API, Frontend) with Docker, accelerating development by up to 80%.
I implemented standardized APIs, improving delivered product quality by 40% and web performance by 25%.
I designed integrations with external services such as Channel Managers, Booking Engines, and Power BI for advanced data automation.
I deployed and maintained VPS infrastructure, and set up and managed the internal GitLab server.
I introduced and implemented rigorous code quality tools across the engineering department.
I supervised and mentored the development team, improving performance and accelerating development cycles by more than 30%.
I wrote and implemented comprehensive documentation for the Unidos API and core backend systems.
I developed more than 13 specialized plugins for the Xedro GESPRO suite, enhancing the Human Resources Management, Project Management, and Decision-Making modules.
